scope: ECC rules/common (all 10 upstream files) plus existing Caveman native-core shared rule; source hashes are upstream originals, destinations are adapted canonical files.
policy: Owner approved test-first default with exceptions,80% changed-code target, substantive independent review when available/permitted,50/800/4 review prompts, contextual immutability, local-first research and runtime authority. Activation deferred.

sources.rationale: Canonical portable team defaults implementing the owner's approved rule decisions; no hook activation or plugin registration.

sections.rationale: Use canonical roles and native delegation; omit ECC installation names, full-roster claims, and irrelevant Rust/HarmonyOS roles.

Independent work may run in parallel when useful; dependent work is sequential and scopes are disjoint.
Delegator collects and integrates results; no fire-and-forget or unnecessary recursive delegation.
Choose perspectives for actual uncertainty rather than a fixed roster.

sections.rationale: Review substantive work independently when available/permitted; small low-risk edits can self-review. Early review may inspect incomplete work honestly.

Review compatibility and behavior; 50/800/4 are assessment prompts; changed-code coverage uses approved target.
Focused review required for auth, secrets, permissions, untrusted input; other boundaries are risk-relevant, not universal STOP triggers.
Critical hazards block affected completion; fix high correctness/security defects rather than approve with warnings; medium/low are proportional.
Native canonical role selection replaces assumed installed provider agents.
Pin full requested diff, inspect boundaries, run relevant checks, assess changed-code coverage, review and report limits.
Security and workload issues retained conditionally; neither automatic splitting nor caching.
Local canonical testing/security/Git/agent links retained.
